newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products - fuel, gasoline tightish.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products - fuel, gasoline tightish.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were broadly steady with prices essentially flat. Gasoline and fuel were tightish and gas oil quiet.

Med fuel oil markets were thinly supplied, with reasonable bunker demand and a scarcity of Russian fuel on offer. Business was quiet, with one big trader manoeuvring to keep high sulphur numbers warm.
But numbers were set to ease in weeks ahead when Italian refiner barrels come to the market and a lack of arbitrage opening forces values down, traders said.
Gas oil outright prices eased 50 cents a tonne, with August IPE closing at $167.00 a tonne. September ended 25 cents adrift at $168.50.

Physical business was meagre but levels were assessed little changed from Friday, with Algeria's August low sulphur diesel loadings absorbing most attention. Low sulphur was offered at +$3.75/$4 fob Italian islands.

A Russian heating oil cargo moved on Friday at high cif Med +$2.75 basis Genoa. Another cargo of 0.2 percent heating oil moved at high fob Med +$3.50/$4.00 to meet the Tunisian tender for 0.7 percent material.
Gasoline remains strong with West African interest continuing to support prices. Dealers said the premium against NWE parcels were around $4.00 a tonne.
Supplies were tight and no cargoes were thought traded today.
